summary: User warned about receiving a fraudulent physical letter impersonating Trezor that claimed an urgent security vulnerability and instructed recipients to scan a QR code to perform a firmware update. The letter is part of a phishing campaign designed to redirect users to a fake website.
user_mistake: Trusted unsolicited security communications appearing to come from a wallet manufacturer
prevention: Ignore unsolicited letters requesting firmware updates or wallet actions / Update devices only through the official Trezor Suite and official website
